name: poor-semantics
description: Same Northwind Bikes content built with divs and spans: onclick navigation, no landmarks, no h1, no lang, generic title, unlabelled inputs without names, images without alt, no JSON-LD, no sitemap, no robots.txt, contact details drawn into a canvas.

notes.robots-agent-access: robots.txt is intentionally absent (404). Per RFC 9309 that means everything is allowed, so the check should not fail; expectation left open.
notes.navigation-links-usable: There is no navigation landmark at all (nav is a div with onclick items), so the check may report fail or na.
notes.images: Images in img/ are local copies and load fine; they simply have no alt attribute.
notes.contact: Email and phone are only present inside the canvas drawing (app.js), never as DOM text, so a text-based agent cannot find them.

tasks.name: find-contact-email
tasks.goal: Find the email address for contacting Northwind Bikes.

tasks.name: find-return-window
tasks.goal: Find out how many days customers have to return a bike.
